title: Highlight Killers and Distance Determiner UPDATED
features:
This script features a lot of optimizations and changes to functionality, making it more efficient and easy to use.

Script Features:

- Settings Tab -
- Fog Removal
- Particles (For the highlight)
- Audio Removal
- Distance GUI (Hide/Show Distance GUI)
- Highlights
————————————————
More features:
- You can now toggle any settings on/off whatever according to your preferences.
- Added a state that indicates whether if you’re in danger or safe. (0-200 studs = danger, 300+ studs = safe.)
- Highlights will now change color depending on how close the killer is to the player. (400-500+ studs = green, 200-399 studs = yellow, 0-200 studs = red).

This script should be more optimized and easy-to-use for both PC & Mobile.

Let me know if you have any idea or suggestions on what should I add.
